description: Get the receipt of a mined Base transaction: success or reverted, gas used, effective gas price, fee paid in ETH, number of event logs and any contract created. Use to confirm a payment or call went through; for sender, value and calldata use base_tx. Input is a 0x-prefixed 64-hex hash; a pending or unknown hash returns 404, uncharged. Example: hash=0x7d108fa131ed949c76d50caf2e7dfe25fc9903b9d276c40a0446d8afbdfe86b0. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only; not marked read-only because each call is charged.
name: base_receipt
title: Base transaction receipt
